app_tagline: The most thrilling Middle Eastern bluff & memory card game online

modes.online_desc: Host or join custom 6-character room codes with friends anywhere
modes.solo_desc: Play offline against heuristic bots or pass-and-play on one screen

game.your_turn: It's your turn! Draw a card or call Skru
game.initial_peek_banner: Memorize your two bottom cards now!

actions.PEEK_OWN: Peek Own (Look at 1 of your cards)
actions.PEEK_OTHER: Peek Other (Look at an opponent card)
actions.PEEK_ALL: Peek All (Peek 1 card of all players)

scorekeeper.title: Digital Skru Tabletop Scorekeeper
scorekeeper.subtitle: Track points for physical card games with automated Skru double penalties
scorekeeper.double_penalty_note: Failed Skru calls double the caller's score as a penalty!

rules.title: Skru Encyclopedia & Rulebook
rules.subtitle: Comprehensive card guide, action rules, and tournament scoring
rules.core_goal: Main Objective: Finish the round with the lowest cumulative sum of 4 cards.
rules.peek_rules: At round start, each player peeks at only their bottom two cards.
rules.skru_penalty: Calling Skru with strictly the lowest score grants 0 points! If anyone ties or beats you, your score doubles!
